recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow current-build source correction that makes the already-approved `$lastn` grouping clarification use the actual FHIR Coding element and an unambiguous example label.
issue_request: FHIR-13860 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Observation change request to clarify `$lastn` behavior: CodeableConcept grouping through non-empty/intersection/transitive equality, inclusion of `entered-in-error` unless status-filtered, returning all effective-time ties even beyond `max`, and grouping text-only CodeableConcepts by text.
initial_application: The issue was historically applied by GF#13860 commits b6ad40bbc2f5218d7e9e1f848ed862a726753c49 and 29d523c8173d2ffd355d5606e88092c6917df0f5, which updated the then-authoritative Observation spreadsheet `$lastn` documentation. That wording later migrated into `source/observation/operationdefinition-Observation-lastn.xml`.
additional_context: Observation is active in `source/fhir.ini`, and `source/observation/list-Observation-operations.xml` references `OperationDefinition/Observation-lastn`, making the edited XML a current build input. The linked 2017 Zulip thread supports system/code equality and transitive grouping. Later FHIR-41448 clarified group ordering and tie wording without reversing FHIR-13860, and FHIR-16439 already fixed a separate text-only table typo on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Changed `coding.value` to `coding.code` and `2 [a.c],[b]` to `2 [a,c],[b]` in `source/observation/operationdefinition-Observation-lastn.xml`, preserving the rest of the applied `$lastn` semantics.
source_changes: source/observation/operationdefinition-Observation-lastn.xml: corrected the `$lastn` description's grouping rule from `coding.value` to `coding.code` and the example group from `[a.c]` to `[a,c]`.
